english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is true most of the time or in most cases.
Use this when largely means that most people, cases, or occasions fall into the stated category.

examples.english: I mostly stay home on Saturdays.
examples.traditional: 我多數星期六留喺屋企。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 do1 sou3 sing1 kei4 luk6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2

examples.traditional: 多數人都贊成呢個做法。
examples.jyutping: do1 sou3 jan4 dou1 zaan3 sing4 ni1 go3 zou6 faat3

english.note: Use this when the likelihood is based on what usually happens or is the expected outcome.

examples.english: With rain this heavy, there will probably be a traffic jam.
examples.jyutping: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 do1 sou3 wui5 sak1 ce1
